content: Vim C++/Python plugin patterns in Nix (nixpkgs vim docs + community configs vim-elysium, vim-python-ide, tagbar, gutentags_plus): canonical shape is vim-full.customize { vimrcConfig.packages.<name>.start/opt = [ plugins ] } with plugins from pkgs.vimPlugins; opt plugins load via :packadd + autocmd FileType; Universal Ctags is the recommended ctags implementation (tagbar docs; exuberant-ctags deprecated). Common language-neutral core: fugitive, fzf, tagbar, gutentags. C++-side: vim-cpp-enhanced-highlight, clangd/coc for LSP completion+diagnostics, gutentags+universal-ctags for symbol navigation, vimspector with CodeLLDB for debugging. Python-side: jedi-vim (goto-def/docstrings), vim-python-pep8-indent, ALE with flake8/pylint/ruff/mypy linters, vimspector with debugpy adapter. vimspector ubiquitous in 'vim as IDE' configs; coc.nvim needs Node at runtime. Nix-managed vim ignores ~/.vimrc; everything goes in vimrcConfig.customRC (nixpkgs docs).
